parameters.name: synonym_set
parameters.description: Filters the results to entries in this synonym set.

schema.description:
The name of a synonym set. A synonym set groups entries, for example, by domain.
Terms must be unique within a set, so different sets can define the same term
differently. The API creates a set when you add its first entry. If you don't
specify a set, the API uses the `default` set.
schema.title: SynonymSetName

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Filters the results to entries that include this tag. Matching is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: synonym_type
parameters.description: Filters the results to entries with this relationship type.

schema.description:
The relationship type, which controls which terms match each other in a search.

- `EQUIVALENT`: the `term` and all its synonyms match each other.
- `ONE_WAY`: the `term` matches its synonyms, but the synonyms don't match the
  `term`. For example, a search for "laptop" finds "notebook," but a search for
  "notebook" doesn't find "laptop."
- `GROUP`: the synonyms match each other. The `term` is only a name for the
  group and isn't used for matching.
schema.title: SynonymType

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Filters the results to entries whose `term` contains this value. Matching is partial and case-insensitive.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: The number of entries to return per page. The maximum is 100.
